description: This file defines an interface ITransactionAgentStatistics that provides methods and properties to track and retrieve statistics related to transactions, such as counts of started, succeeded, failed, and throttled transactions within the Orleans transactions framework.

classes.name: ITransactionAgentStatistics
classes.description: Interface for tracking transaction statistics including counts for started, succeeded, failed, and throttled transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionStarted
methods.description: Method to record that a transaction has started.

methods.name: TransactionsStarted
methods.description: Property to get the total number of transactions started.

methods.name: TrackTransactionSucceeded
methods.description: Method to record a successful transaction.

methods.name: TransactionsSucceeded
methods.description: Property to get the total number of successful transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionFailed
methods.description: Method to record a failed transaction.

methods.name: TransactionsFailed
methods.description: Property to get the total number of failed transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionThrottled
methods.description: Method to record a throttled transaction.

methods.name: TransactionsThrottled
methods.description: Property to get the total number of throttled transactions.
